items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could lead to arbitrary code execution upon successful exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack customer accounts and access private data.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (Arbitrary Code Execution)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (Arbitrary Code Execution)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security Feature Bypass in B2B)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for dozens of extensions, including two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.
